buyModifier.label: Buy Modifier
buyModifier.hint: Percentage adjustment applied to item prices in this shop's Buy tab. Negative values lower the price, positive values raise it. Individual items can override this.

sellModifier.label: Sell Modifier
sellModifier.hint: Percentage adjustment applied to item prices in this shop's Sell tab. Negative values lower what the shop pays out, positive values raise it.

Shops.DeleteConfirm: Delete this shop? This cannot be undone.

ShopEditor.Title: Edit Shop
ShopEditor.BuyModifierHint: Default buy-side price modifier in percent (negative = discount, positive = markup).
ShopEditor.SellModifierHint: Default sell-back price modifier in percent (negative = discount, positive = markup).
ShopEditor.NoRestockHint: This item stays depleted after being bought out — Reset won't restock it.
ShopEditor.NoActorForSell: No character selected — pick one under "Acting As" first.
ShopEditor.SuppressedNotFound: Item not found in active compendiums — check the identifier or enabled rulebooks

ShopCart.Title: Shopping Cart
ShopCart.NoActor: No character selected — pick one under "Acting As" first.
ShopCart.NoActiveGM: No GM is currently online — purchases can only be completed while a GM is connected.
ShopCart.PurchaseRequested: Purchase request sent — waiting for GM confirmation.

PurchaseCard.InsufficientStock: Not enough stock left for one or more items — purchase not completed.
PurchaseCard.InsufficientSellQuantity: The seller no longer has enough of one or more items — sale not completed.
PurchaseCard.InsufficientShopGold: The shop doesn't have enough gold to buy these items — sale not completed.
PurchaseCard.MissingActor: The buying character could no longer be found.
PurchaseCard.MissingShop: The shop this purchase belongs to could no longer be found.
PurchaseCard.MissingItem: One of the purchased items could no longer be resolved.
